description: Find US water-quality monitoring stations (streams, lakes, wells, estuaries) by state, county, HUC, bounding box or organization. AUTHORITATIVE for "where is water sampled near X" — returns the station id you then pass to wqp_get_results, plus coordinates, site type, and how many results each station holds. Sourced from the USGS/EPA Water Quality Portal (NWIS + STORET + STEWARDS).

characteristicName.description: Only stations that have sampled this characteristic, e.g. "Nitrate", "pH", "Lead"

countycode.description: FIPS county code in WQP form, e.g. "US:06:081" for San Mateo County CA

huc.description: Hydrologic unit code, e.g. "18050004" or a wildcard like "1805*"

statecode.description: FIPS state code in WQP form, e.g. "US:06" for California

name: wqp_search_sites
title: Wqp Search Sites
